description: No mechanism exists for data subjects to withdraw consent as easily as it was given. Article 7.3 requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent and that data subjects are informed of withdrawal right.
applicability: Applicable to all consent-based processing. Withdrawal mechanism must be available, accessible, and as easy to use as initial consent mechanism. Processing must stop upon withdrawal.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of consent management systems and absence of clear, accessible withdrawal mechanisms.
